description: This source file defines a serializer (codec) for the DateTimeOffset type within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods to write and read DateTimeOffset instances to/from a serialized form, handling fields for DateTime and Offset. The class uses various internal codecs and serialization mechanisms specific to Orleans.

classes.name: DateTimeOffsetCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for DateTimeOffset, responsible for serializing and deserializing DateTimeOffset values.

methods.name: WriteField<TBufferWriter>
methods.description: Static method to serialize a DateTimeOffset value with type info, writing its DateTime and Offset parts.

methods.name: ReadValue<TInput>
methods.description: Static method to deserialize a DateTimeOffset value from the reader, reading DateTime and Offset fields.
